Name: Miraidon (Pokemon) - Horse Replacer
Author: Silverinnia
Description:
[center][b][size=3]~ Installation ~
[/size][/b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Download and unzip file
3. Place folder in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
4. Run game with SMAPI[/center]

Horse retexture requested by WolfSnek-Emerald to change the horse into Miraidon from Pokemon Violet. Only changes the appearance so it will still make galloping sounds. You can make it silent using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13428]Change Horse Sounds[/url].

Koraidon can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20297]here[/url]. Only install one at a time. Miraidon and Koraidon will not work together since they are replacers.

Manifest.Name: Miraidon Horse Replacer
Manifest.Description: CP replacement texture to turn your horse into Miraidon.
